fidelity_precondition: F-AHL21H 12/12 PASS with identical nonlinear iteration and backtracking path.
finding: Authoritative theta/C plus selected K lookup is numerically clean under the qualified prescribed-qbot matrix but provides no complete-Richards speed benefit. Most tested cases are modestly slower than the fully analytical provider.
architectural_implication: Adaptive hydraulic acceleration should be boundary-mode aware. The qualified lookup representation remains a speed candidate for prescribed-head routes, while prescribed-qbot should fall back to the authoritative analytical provider unless a future different representation demonstrates benefit.
nonclaims: This does not reject adaptive hydraulics for other lower-boundary modes.
No MODFLOW coupling performance claim is made.
